abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. You can't use more than 1 Dark Asset Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Power Accelerator
attacks.text: You may attach a Darkness Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamax Cannon
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon VMAX, it does 120 more damage.

abilities.name: Eternal Zone
abilities.text: If all of your Pokémon in play are Darkness type, you can have up to 8 Pokémon on your Bench, and you can't put non-Darkness Pokémon into play. (If this Ability stops working, discard Pokémon from your Bench until you have 5.)

attacks.name: Dread End
attacks.text: Does 30 damage for each of your Darkness Pokémon in play.

cards.name: Adventurer's Discovery
cards.text: Look through your deck for up to 3 Pokémon V, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Kabu
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your Active Pokémon is your only Pokémon in play, draw 8 cards instead.

cards.name: Opal
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. Look through your deck for a number of cards up to the number of heads, put them into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
